name: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company
summary: Walaa Cooperative Insurance Company provides cooperative insurance and reinsurance products and services in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company offers motor insurance products, which include commercial and private motor comprehensive, and third party liability policies; travel; medical marketplace; home; shop; SME medical; worker health; and saving and protection insurance products.
